 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    scaffold = {v for v, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

    # Non-scaffold cells are the colored lattice samples. Treat each 2x2
    # window of their row/column lattice as one output cell, keeping a color
    # only when all four samples agree.
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] not in scaffold]
    rows = sorted({r for r, _ in points})
    cols = sorted({c for _, c in points})
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return [[background]]

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            vals = [grid[rows[i] + di][cols[j] + dj]
                    for di in (0, 1) for dj in (0, 1)]
            row.append(vals[0] if all(v == vals[0] for v in vals) else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
